heads.en: It's only been three years since Xiao Zheng was married to a "separate" wife, and the manager's company has responded with urgency to the fact that King Xiao Zheng Zheng and the manager's wife Summer have been in love for 16 years and finally entered into marriage in 2023 and held a wedding the following year. It is understood that both spouses had a large home in the same community before marriage, that they retained their usual habits after marriage, that they moved in different spaces during the day and that they did not sleep together until night. However, instead of being emotional, the two are used to keeping room for one person, and Xiao Zheng has recently decided to spend tens of thousands of dollars to reset their homes and transform their former single home into a love nest. 13 minutes ago, we were married three years ago.

heads.t: 美國科技系統接連故障 AI加劇資安壓力、老舊基礎設施成隱憂 美國近期多項重要科技系統接連發生故障，從航空交通、銀行交易到政府機關及科技公司內部網路均受到影響，引發外界對科技基礎設施可靠性的疑慮。儘管目前沒有證據顯示這些事件彼此相關，或是由駭客攻擊造成，但專家警告，隨著人工智慧（AI）加快資安漏洞的發現速度，企業及政府機關也面臨加速修補的壓力，老舊系統可能因此承受更大的營運負擔。 17 分鐘前｜科技 美國科技系統接連故障 AI加劇資安壓力、老舊基礎設施成隱憂 17 分鐘前｜科技
heads.en: There have been a number of recent failures in the U.S.'s major technological systems, from air traffic, bank transactions to government agencies and networks within technology companies, which have raised concerns about the reliability of technology infrastructure. Although there is currently no evidence that these incidents are related to each other, or that they were caused by hacker attacks, experts warn that the old system may bear a greater burden of business as AI accelerates the discovery of financial gaps and companies and government institutions face pressure to repair them. 17 minutes ago, the technology system in the U.S. failed.
